countries.source: NELEX, Federal Ministry of Labour and Employment
countries.notes: Public list of registered private employment agencies (80 pages). Publishes name, email and a CAC-verified flag; no licence numbers, expiry dates or phone numbers. All listed entries are shown as active by the site.
run_notes: NELEX lists no licence number, phone, address or licence dates; emails are Cloudflare-obfuscated in the HTML and were decoded.

countries.source: NEA register of private recruitment agencies, via State Department for Diaspora Affairs (diaspora.go.ke)
countries.notes: The NEAIMS portal refused connections from outside Kenya; the diaspora.go.ke verification page loads the same NEA register as JSON, last updated 18 May 2026. Holds licence numbers, validity and email; 515 entries were valid at snapshot, the rest expired.
run_notes: (b) diaspora.go.ke/verify: HTTP 200; register endpoint in page source: https://diaspora.go.ke/agencies.json
(b) https://diaspora.go.ke/agencies.json: HTTP 200, 1296 rows, Last-Modified Mon, 18 May 2026 21:00:03 GMT
worked: option (b) api https://diaspora.go.ke/agencies.json; status counts: {"active":515,"expired":780}
Register carries NEA reg no, email, website, service type and Valid/Expired status only; no phones, addresses or licence dates. as_of is the Last-Modified date of agencies.json.

countries.source: EEMIS, Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development
countries.notes: Licensed external recruitment companies only; the register lists currently licensed firms, so companies whose licences were revoked in April 2026 do not appear. Holds phone, email, address and licence validity dates.
run_notes: status counts: {"active":181}; 0 entries have a licence expiry date already in the past despite ACTIVE badge
EEMIS public listing only exposes ACTIVE companies; there is no public list of suspended or expired licences. Licence no, dates, address, phone and email come from each company detail page.

countries.source: GLMIS, Ministry of Employment and Labour Relations
countries.notes: Directory of employment agencies (government and private) with email and location. Carries no licence status; the Ministry announced a licensed-agency list on 8 September 2026 and this snapshot should be replaced by it when published.
run_notes: status counts (derived from licence end date, GLMIS shows no explicit status): {"unknown":59,"active":256}; types: {"government":59,"private":256}
GLMIS has no licence number field; "Location" is usually a Ghana digital address (e.g. GD-211-0600). Government entries are public labour offices, not recruiters.
